notes.title: Good Night, Knight is ON! ⚔️ Save 20% OFF NOW!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35591034/861d14c8a6da7a772d75d9f300d7f650c34276a5.jpg[/img]

[h1]⚔️ Welcome to the fray, Knights! ⚔️[/h1]
[b]We are very excited to announce that Good Night, Knight is now available in Early Access! [/b]

A dynamic sneak-and-slash RPG that mixes procedural generation with hand-made scenarios and a darkly humorous story. Created almost entirely by just one developer (!) game features heavy-hitting deliberate combat, robust stealth mechanics, threatening enemies with unique movesets and a vast array of game-changing items to discover.

[h1]Good Night, Knight is now 20% OFF![/h1]

Of course, it’s just the beginning of the adventure. Even though Good Night, Knight is already packed with features, we have new areas and challenges planned for players. Today we're revealing our roadmap with an overview of some of the planned major updates!

The journey goes on, here's our roadmap for Good Night, Knight (please click to enlarge):
[url=https://i.imgur.com/Cd6FqUS.png]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35591034/46bfe90f41bb44d47864326b78a1066eef02c2c2.png[/img]
[/url]

Play, experience crazy adventures, loot, sneak, slash, and don’t forget to share your opinion with us on the Steam forum, and if possible leave a review after! At this point of development every voice matters, help us make Good Night, Knight even better!

Cheers,
No Gravity Games

notes.title: Do crazy flips! REKT: High Octane Stunts is OUT on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35591034/d5f7d684550c7df34b51eedd77825ba06a3f6f64.jpg[/img]

[h1]We are extremely happy to announce that REKT: High Octane Stunts has been just released on Steam.[/h1]

REKT! High Octane Stunts is an action-packed driving game inspired by the eternal classics like Rush and Tony Hawk's Pro Skater series. 

Perform difficult backflips, do amazing drifts, spin around, and master all the tricks to become an ultimate stunter! 
Feel the nostalgic Micro Machines vibe but covered with new retro neon graphics. Invite your friends to double, triple, or even quadruple the fun! 
All in smooth 60 frames per second performance.

[b]The game is available 10 languages.[/b]

[h1]REKT! High Octane Stunts is 5,99 USD / 4,99 EUR.
It is 20% OFF for the launch week![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1065320/REKT_High_Octane_Stunts/

notes.title: Get the demo! Perform crazy stunts! Win Steam Gift Cards (50$/20$/10$)!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35591034/972d4be78cc87e500710f4f08a9fe62117d52868.jpg[/img]

[b]The Steam Game Festival Autumn Edition has started and so REKT! High Octane Stunts demo is released.[/b]

[h1]We have a very crazy contest for you! 
Join @REKTChallenge to win $50, $20, and $10 worth Steam Gift Cards![/h1]

Grab the steering wheel of nitro-powered racing cars and perform the most incredible of freestyle stunts.

Take part in #REKTChallenge, a competition in which you gain points by performing car stunts (tricks, spirals, spins, perfect landings, flying through special circles). 
In the demo, there is a time limit set to 1:00 except that during the ride players can collect objects that expand and add a few seconds, so they can play for a bit longer. 
The event starts on October 7th and ends on October 13th. 
The 6 participants with the highest scores documented on the Leaderboard will receive Steam Gift Cards worth:
[list]
[*] 1st place - $50
[*] 2nd and 3rd place - $25
[*] 4th, 5th, and 6th place - $10 
[/list]
Winners will be announced on Rekt! High Octane Stunts store page no later than 19th October.

[h1]Click to join @REKTChallenge now![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1065320/REKT_High_Octane_Stunts/

notes.title: It's time to wake up! Good Night, Knight, hilarious dungeon-crawler is now available for wishlisting!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35591034/86a779a39ac08f5198ac87f5926acaafb7594762.jpg[/img]

[i]- How does it go, again?
- The Knight fell from the Spire, and then died. The End.[/i]

Well, almost...
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gxTr4qWCFWo&t=26s
Good Night, Knight is a dynamic sneak-and-slash RPG that mixes procedural generation with hand-made puzzles and story! Featuring heavy-hitting deliberate combat, robust stealth mechanics, a huge selection of versatile items, and unique threatening enemies to face!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133050/Good_Night_Knight/

[h1][b]ABOUT THE GAME:[/b][/h1]
Become the one and only - extremely honorable, brave and … a little bit sleepy, Knight of the Holy Divers. The ancient evil has been banished, the princess rescued and the Knight retires - but something is wrong. You awake falling to your death - probably -  from the top of the mysterious underworld spire. Regain your memories and to save the world - most likely - again.  Go forth Holy Diver it’s - definitely - all up to you.

Good Night, Knight is a humorous twist on stories you likely already know from fantasy books and games, set in a pixel medieval world. With a range of unique and peculiar knights, creatures and many different story events Good Night, Knight offers a truly unusual experience. 

This charming 16-bit sneak-and-slash adventure is a mechanically-deep dungeon crawler featuring robust stealth, stamina management, a dynamic field-of-view system, versatile items, resource management, and much more to discover!

[h1][b]KEY FEATURES:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Strategic heavy-hitting combat[/b]: Skill, timing, and good positioning are key to your survival.
[*] [b]Robust stealth elements[/b]: Sneak, peek around corners, with the help of the dynamic field-of-view system and learn where enemies are patrolling to catch them off-guard. Or hack-and-slash your way through them all!
[*] [b]Procedurally generated dungeons[/b]: Randomly generated areas and a mix of hand-made puzzles make each campaign unique and interesting.
[*] [b]Huge amounts of loot to find and equip[/b]: Mix and match gear, potions, and curses to find your preferred playstyle.
[*] [b]Risk/Reward management[/b]: Choose between retreating to rest or venturing onwards for extra rewards.
[*] [b]Extra challenges[/b]: Enable many different extra challenge modifiers for even more rewards, but don't get too greedy!
[*] [b]Prepare yourself for battle[/b]: Food, ingredients, and provisions help you stay in top shape during battles. Gather resources during combat, and manage how much to spend during preparations.
[*] [b]No permadeath[/b]: Progress is saved while advancing through the campaign. And just like real life, death can still be very costly.
[*] [b]Optional Ironman mode[/b]: In this game mode, if you die, everything is lost! Only for the toughest Knights!
[*] [b]Dog petting[/b]: Pet a dog.
[/list]

[h1][b]Wishlist the game now![/b][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133050/Good_Night_Knight/

Alder’s Blood - a highly anticipated, one of a kind, hauntingly beautiful strategy title by Shockwork Games has just launched a Kickstarter campaign.
For everyone who likes the idea behind this title, and would like to back the project - follow the link below and make a pledge. Your support is truly appreciated!

Shockwork Games aim to deliver a truly amazing experience that will leave all hunters curious enough to take up the mantle satisfied and wanting more.

notes.title: New content update for Summer Sale!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have some good news for you! :)

[b]A new content update and patch will be available on Steam Summer Sale![/b]

[h1]We addressed most of the issues and fixed most of the bugs reported by the players, related to:[/h1][list]
[*][b]stability,[/b] 
[*][b]visuals,[/b]
[*][b]game mechanics.[/b][/list]

[h1]We have also added new features for you to enjoy.[/h1]

From now on you will be able to:
 
[b]- Adjust “jumpscares” in the Options Menu.[/b]
You can now turn the jump scares off in the Options Menu at any time during the game. 
Also, all of the available jumpscares occur just once in the gameplay.

[b]- Enjoy new riddles.[/b]
We added new environmental riddles. 
You can explore your surroundings and solve them to complete The Alphabet. 
The tasks are not related to the main story.

Thank you and stay tuned!

Inner Voices team.

If Inner Voices's release on Steam taught me anything - is that I was right. Interacting with you guys is the greatest aspect of making games. We won't be here without you, we wouldn't even leave Greenlight. Without you - no game would ever got done. You are the most awesome muse any artist can wish for. You. The player. 

So I wrote an article about this 'discovery'. So maybe other Devs will get the idea and we'll ignite a new trend =) Have a read.
http://www.gamasutra.com/blogs/RadekBazak/20170517/298121/Biggest_LifeHack_of_IndieDev_Talk_to_them_.php

Thank you! And Best Regards!
~Whole team of Inner Voices
